column4: I WILL PRAY EVERY DAY THAT SOON, YOU'LL END UP LOOKING JUST LIKE THIS, DEAR SISTER.
REALLY CAN'T SEEM TO REALIZE THAT THERE ARE LINES YOU SHOULDN'T CROSS
JUST HOW FAR ARE YOU WILLING TO FALL BEFORE YOU'RE SATISFIED?
WAS SHOWING YOURSELF AT ROCK BOTTOM NOT ENOUGH?
ME, SHOWING MYSELF AT ROCK BOTTOM?
DON'T ACT SO HIGH AND MIGHTY, NOBLE LORD SIARKAN.
DO YOU REALLY THINK YOU HAVE THE SLIGHTEST CLUE OF WHAT ROCK BOTTOM IS?
PERHAPS, FROM WHERE YOU STAND, I INDEED LOOK VERY LOW.
HOWEVER, I'M STILL FAR FROM THE WORST I CAN BE.
IN THOSE : EYES, THEREIN LIE. S..
SOONER OR LATER, THIS MAN WILL PUSH ME INTO IT.
IF SO, THE LEAST I CAN DO IS LEAVE CLAW MARKS ON HIS FUTURE BEFORE I FALL.
ONLY WTH THAT IT'LL BE FAIR!!
I... WANT TO CHANGE MY CLOTHES.
COULD YOU ESCORT ME OUT OF HERE?
I BELIEVE IT WOULD BE BEST FOR YOU TO LEAVE THE BANQUET HALL IMMEDIATELY.
DID YOU NOT HEAR THE FIRST PRINCESS TELL ME TO ENJOY THE BANQUET TO MY HEART'S CONTENT?
I HAVEN'T ENJOYED IT NEARLY ENOUGH YET.
WHILE I HIGHLY ADMIRE YOUR BOLDNESS, YOUR HIGHNESS...
... THE BEAST BEHIND YOU LOOKS AS IF HE'S READY TO POUNCE.
YOUR HIGHNESS, WHAT IS THE MEANING OF...
